title: Registration

title: Input validation

title: Marketplace
description: Browse second-hand textbook listings with prices, sellers and universities.
alt: EduSwap: Marketplace. Browse second-hand textbook listings with prices, sellers and universities.

title: Search
description: The implemented search filters textbook listings by title.
alt: EduSwap: Search. The implemented search filters textbook listings by title.

title: Book details
description: View the book’s price, condition, author and seller details.
alt: EduSwap: Book details. View the book’s price, condition, author and seller details.

title: Sell a textbook
description: Create a textbook listing with relevant details and device-selected images.
alt: EduSwap: Sell a textbook. Create a textbook listing with relevant details and device-selected images.

title: Inquiry / chat
description: Send a simple textbook inquiry, with blank-message validation and self-message prevention.
alt: EduSwap: Inquiry / chat. Send a simple textbook inquiry, with blank-message validation and self-message prevention.

title: Student profile
description: View profile details and manage your own listings.
alt: EduSwap: Student profile. View profile details and manage your own listings.

title: Book catalogue
description: Browse the local catalogue with title, author, category and availability badges.
alt: Kitabu: Book catalogue. Browse the local catalogue with title, author, category and availability badges.

title: Title and author search
description: Filter the catalogue to locate matching titles or authors.
alt: Kitabu: Title and author search. Filter the catalogue to locate matching titles or authors.

title: Reserve a book
description: Choose a 7, 14 or 21-day rental period for an available book.
alt: Kitabu: Reserve a book. Choose a 7, 14 or 21-day rental period for an available book.

title: Pending reservation
description: Review a PENDING booking and its deadline; confirm pickup or cancel it.
alt: Kitabu: Pending reservation. Review a PENDING booking and its deadline; confirm pickup or cancel it.

title: Pickup confirmed
description: After pickup confirmation, the booking is ACTIVE and offers renewal and return actions.
alt: Kitabu: Pickup confirmed. After pickup confirmation, the booking is ACTIVE and offers renewal and return actions.

title: Renew a rental
description: Extend an active rental by selecting an additional rental period.
alt: Kitabu: Renew a rental. Extend an active rental by selecting an additional rental period.

title: Book returned
description: Returning a book marks the booking RETURNED and restores catalogue availability.
alt: Kitabu: Book returned. Returning a book marks the booking RETURNED and restores catalogue availability.

title: Cancel a pending reservation
description: Pending bookings offer cancellation, which removes the booking and releases the book.
alt: Kitabu: Cancel a pending reservation. Pending bookings offer cancellation, which removes the booking and releases the book.

title: Empty reservations
description: An honest empty state appears when there are no current reservations.
alt: Kitabu: Empty reservations. An honest empty state appears when there are no current reservations.
